thread:
maria-sec: Heads up — Acme sent back the SQ with 3 followups: impact of our recent RBAC roles change, proof of immutable audit logs for last 12 months, and KMS envelope/key rotation evidence. They want a concise runbook we can walk through on the call. Call scheduled 10:30 PT tomorrow. @elena-sre @chetan can you quick-scan?
elena-sre: copying runbook excerpt now. main points: how we grant service-account roles, automated rotation windows, and log shipping to SIEM (immutable S3 + checksum). attaching snippet in chat. :white_check_mark:
chetan: quick notes — RBAC change was scoped to controller and deployer roles only. No change to customer-tenant service accounts. I have the change PR hash and approval log. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/9876
ryan-eng: for audit proof we can produce signed log bundles using the log-export tool. Example command we used for PSC ask: 
```
redwood-ops log-export --since=2024-03-01 --until=2025-03-01 \
  --sign-with=/etc/keys/export_signing.key \
  --output=acme_logbundle_202403-202503.tar.gz
```
ryan-eng: bundles include a sha256sum and GPG signature. We also upload to a customer-only S3 bucket with retention policy = 12 months + WORM flag.
sam-pe: Acme specifically asked for KMS key rotation proof and key access logs. We use cloud KMS (managed) with envelope wrapping. Can we produce a short statement + audit trail?
chetan: yes — key metadata export available from KMS admin API. Example fields: key_id, creation_ts, rotation_schedule, last_rotation_ts, key_policy_snapshot (base64). I'll export and redact ARNs.
maria-sec: also need to call out who has access to key material: we have no plaintext keys, only envelope keys; HSM-managed master key in customer-tenant KMS for Private customers. For hosted accounts we use Redwood-managed CMKs; ops-only access is logged.
acme-sec: is there an SLA for log availability if we need forensic snapshots?
elena-sre: we guarantee 72h for ad-hoc forensic export within our standard enterprise support. For anything beyond, we do a scheduled export and hand off signed bundle.
maria-sec: vuln triage note — there was a low/medium finding last quarter about rotated service tokens not being invalidated on async workers. Fix deployed in prod, release tag `fix/async-token-rotation-2025-02`, ticket #ENG-5221. We'll include A/C and test run results in the packet.
deploy-bot: meeting created: "Acme security follow-up" — 2025-04-14 10:30 PT — https://calendar.internal/meet/abcd1234 :calendar:
maria-sec: action items before call: 1) @chetan export RBAC change audit + PR approvals (artifact) 2) @ryan-eng produce signed log bundle for last 12 months (sample) 3) @elena-sre produce SIEM ingest proof + S3 WORM policy text 4) @sam-pe draft KMS key rotation statement and redacted key metadata 5) I will draft the 1-page runbook and FAQ for the call. Please drop artifacts as presigned links in this thread by EOD today.
ryan-eng: starting log export now, ETA ~2h. will upload to `s3://enterprise-evidence/acme/1770000000/` and paste presigned link.
chetan: grabbed PR approval logs, redacting emails and will upload as `rbac_change_approvals.json` (signed). ETA 30m.
elena-sre: SIEM proof: I will paste the config snippet and retention policy. snippet: 
```
# Kinesis -> S3 immutable export
kinesis_stream: redwood-audit
s3_dest: s3://redwood-audit-immutable
lifecycle: Retain 395 days
object_lock: GOVERNANCE
```
Uploading policy doc now.
maria-sec: great. one last ask from Acme: they want IR playbook excerpt showing escalation path and timeframe for notifying customers in case of key compromise. We have the standard IR doc but please extract the "KMS compromise" section. Keep it customer-facing.
sam-pe: pulling that section, will redact internal addresses.
maria-sec: perfect. I'll assemble and send to Acme before the call. Thanks everyone :pray:
acme-sec: really appreciate the fast turnaround. we'll review the artifacts once posted and prepare a short list of clarifying Qs for tomorrow.
notes: This thread is an internal coordination thread prepping artifacts and runbook snippets for an enterprise security questionnaire follow-up call. Includes short commands, config snippets, and action items.
